name: crime_average
description: Test 12. average = (sum of values) / count over the crime-grid tracts whose corner cell (x S, z S) has a zone type != 0, with integer sums, stored as float32; GetAverageCrime = trunc(average). S = 2: tracts (0,0), (1,0), (2,0) have corner cells (0,0), (2,0), (4,0). Values {10, 20, 0} zoned, plus an unzoned tract of 200 that is ignored -> 30 / 3 = 10.0 -> 10. With only (0,0), (2,0) zoned and values {1, 2} -> 1.5 -> GetAverageCrime 1. A zone on a non-corner cell (1,0) does not count. Unzoned city: [choice] FreeCity4 stores 0 and returns 0 (the original computes 0/0 = NaN and returns 0x80000000). Hand-derived.
